purpose: Verify same regular-file tree/content operation and distinguish modification-time preservation for plain rcp versus archive cp.

fixture.construction: file0 contains bytes(range(250)) repeated four times; file mode 0644; directory mode 0755; source atime/mtime originally set to 946684800123456789 ns.
fixture.reproducer_python:
import hashlib, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="rcp-recipe-check-", dir="/tmp"))
source = root / "source"
source.mkdir()
file = source / "file0"
file.write_bytes(bytes(range(250)) * 4)
os.chmod(source, 0o755)
os.chmod(file, 0o644)
stamp = 946684800123456789
os.utime(file, ns=(stamp, stamp))
os.utime(source, ns=(stamp, stamp))
rcp = "/home/mateusz/projects/rcp/main/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/rcp"
subprocess.run([rcp, str(source), str(root / "rcp-default")], check=True)
subprocess.run(["cp", "--reflink=auto", "-a", str(source), str(root / "cp-archive")], check=True)
for name in ["source", "rcp-default", "cp-archive"]:
    tree = root / name
    file = tree / "file0"
    print(name, hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "file_mtime_ns", file.stat().st_mtime_ns,
          "directory_mtime_ns", tree.stat().st_mtime_ns)
print("fixture:", root)
